What is Project Fi, how does it work and why do I want it?

Fi is focused on simplified billing. You pay $20 per month for unlimited talk and texting, and a flat rate of $10 per gigabyte of data used. Data used internationally just comes out of your standard $10 per gigabyte bucket, but speeds are limited to 256kbps (double what T-Mobile offers outside of North America).

Ever since roughly October of 2014 Gamers have been subjected to a slew of misrepresentation, insults, name calling, harassment, and public shaming by the media in the U.S. and UK. Gamers like myself have been stereotyped as misogynistic white cis males who live in their parent's basements. This sparked GamerGate (term coined by Adam Baldwin) supporters to start the hashtag NotYourShield. For example, I am not your shield to be racist and sexist towards straight White Men, as I am a straight Black Man. Countless LGBT and other Minorities came out in support of GamerGate and NotYourShield as well.. I was even hacked by anti-GamerGate SJWs from a spoofed IP from London and Belfast. It was at that time I realized how big the issue and the gaming industry was and what its going to take to remove corruption from the industry, discussion. I've opened up this discussion board for people to share their views on GamerGate, comments, experiences, and knowledge on the Gaming Industry. I feel as though we don't have "safe spaces" anymore where we can discuss all matters of the gaming culture but just found this site and hope it values the epicness of free speech.
